summary:
The AI-Powered Solar Butterfly is an innovative project that combines Artificial Intelligence, MATLAB Simulink simulation, wireless energy transfer, and a battery-powered motor system.
The project uses a simulated butterfly model as its input, which is connected to an AI-based processing unit. 
The processed signals are transferred through a transmitter and receiver (TX & RX) system. The wireless energy transfer section uses coil-based electromagnetic coupling to transfer energy to the receiving side. The received energy is intended to support a battery and motor-based system.
The main objective of this project is to explore intelligent signal processing and wireless power transfer through simulation. 
MATLAB Simulink is used to design the system architecture, connect functional blocks, and study the interaction between different components.
This project demonstrates the potential integration of AI, wireless technology, and energy-efficient systems. It can be further developed for smart energy applications and innovative robotic systems.
